description: CSGLite is a lightweight local LLM inference platform. One command downloads, loads, and chats with models. It   ships a web UI, OpenAI-compatible API, llama.cpp inference, resumable downloads, marketplace browsing, and one-click AI app and  coding-agent setup—all in a single cross-platform binary.
